newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.187pts to 103.442.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.187pts to 103.442.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.187 points in Wednesday's trading to 103.442 bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.059 points to 2.212 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.082 points to 99.743, points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.207 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 6.668 points to 1,026.091.
